fusions.name: Windlass Bolt
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second cast, looses a bolt that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Revolving Quiver
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back. Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, and each deals 6 damage.

fusions.name: Quick Nocking Cycle
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cranked Tension
fusions.desc: Every hit you land winds a stack onto you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
